descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
You are in the batter's box. The pitcher sets sixty feet six inches away, comes set, and throws — a four-seam at the top of the zone, a slider off the plate, a curveball you were already out in front of.

**Fast Baseball VR is about the half-second between release and contact, and nothing else.** No baserunning, no fielding, no roster management. Tap the bat and he throws again.

**Six ways to play**
• **Free Play** — bat until three strikes. A foul is never the third.
• **Heat** — starts at 40 mph and gets faster every single pitch.
• **Home Run Rush** — home runs only. Everything else is an out.
• **Pure Contact** — three lives. A foul or a miss costs one.
• **Twelve Pitches** — no outs, always a score. The one you cannot lose.
• **The Chase** — reach a target before the pitches run out.

**Nine skies.** Classic, Orbital, Dune Sunset, Thunderdome, Skyfields, Aurora Ice, Ashfall, Lantern Dusk and Prism Arena — one open field, nine worlds.

**Built on real physics.** Every pitch is solved, not animated: real speed, real movement, a real strike zone, and your swing read at frame rate. Pick a park at 250, 375 or 400 feet and find out how far you can carry one.

**Made to fit you.** Assists if you want them and none if you do not — barrel size, power, ball size, a landing marker, a visible strike zone. One controller, either hand, seated or standing.

The soundtrack is the developer's own song.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by any baseball league, team, or player.
